list.name: scan
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, id AS __text FROM scans WHERE status='done' ORDER BY id DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT rank_risk, rank_cvss_only, rank_zap_risk_only, rank_weighted_sum, type, url, round(risk::numeric, 1) AS risk FROM findings WHERE scan_id = $scan AND rank_risk <= 10 ORDER BY rank_risk

panels.title: Framework risk of top findings across scans

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.finished_at AS time, f.type AS metric, f.risk AS value FROM findings f JOIN scans s ON s.id = f.scan_id WHERE f.rank_risk <= 10 AND s.status = 'done' ORDER BY 1
